entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the Onslaught story takes place, about a century after the Invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The devastated plane on which Otaria lies.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A man who relocates to the Krosan Forest with the Mirari and becomes a druid of Krosa.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest whose residents are mutated and grown gigantic by the Mirari's power.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact that begins to transform the Krosan Forest.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, transformed by foul Cabal healing magic.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Jeska's transformed identity, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: An illusionist who discovers his powers of reality sculpting.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group whose foul healing magic transforms Jeska.
